meta.title: Checkout
meta.subtitle: Cash on Delivery only. We call to confirm every order before it leaves the workshop.

empty.title: Your bag is empty
empty.text: Add a piece to your bag and it will show up here, ready for Cash on Delivery.

delivery.notesPlaceholder: Engraving initials, gift wrapping, delivery timing…

payment.codText: Pay the courier in cash when your parcel arrives. Open the box, check the stitching and the colour, then hand over the money. It's the only payment method we offer.

errors.phone: Enter a valid Moroccan number, e.g. 0612345678
errors.address: Please give a full street address

success.toast: Order placed — we'll call you shortly.

orderSuccess.title: Thank you — your order is confirmed
orderSuccess.text: A maker in Taroudant is already wrapping your piece. You'll pay the courier in cash when it arrives — no card, no prepayment.

received.title: Order received
received.text: We've logged your order and reserved your piece.

call.title: Confirmation call
call.text: A quick call within a few hours to confirm your address.

delivery.title: Out for delivery
delivery.text: 24–48h in major cities, 2–4 days elsewhere. Pay the courier.

orderSuccess.whatsappNote: I'd like an update on order {{order}}.
